visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male creator with styled black hair and a white short-sleeved t-shirt stands in a bright indoor room. He has a black band on his forearm and smiles excitedly while holding a large, white spiral-bound book. Behind him is a white bookshelf densely packed with books of various colors. No text overlays are visible yet. (2) He points to the book cover featuring his younger self and then places a small rectangular photo of the boy band Fahrenheit on top of it. His facial expression is one of amused nostalgia as he looks directly into the lens. The lighting is even and bright, highlighting the glossy surface of the book. (3) The creator opens the book to show detailed makeup tutorials with close-up photos of eyes and skin. He uses his fingers to flip through the pages, which are physically split into three horizontal sections. The background remains the same bookshelf, but the focus is now on the book's internal illustrations. (4) The camera zooms in as he flips the horizontal strips of the 'face-changing' pages rapidly, showing how different eyes and lips can be combined. His movements are quick and deliberate. Yellow and white variety-style captions appear at the bottom of the screen, emphasizing the 'face-changing' concept. (5) He turns to a page with large black text titled '10 Items to Make You Beautiful'. He points at the list and speaks with high energy, often touching his chin or gesturing with his hands. The camera captures his upper body and head, maintaining an eye-level perspective.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker begins with a high-energy greeting, his voice characterized by a bright timbre and clear articulation. The vocal pitch is moderately high, reflecting excitement. Simultaneously, an upbeat acoustic guitar-driven BGM starts, featuring a steady 100 BPM tempo and bright spectral weight. (2) As he mentions a specific band, a distinct 'ding' SFX with a high-frequency transient is heard. The speaker's delivery becomes more rhythmic, matching the light percussion in the background music. The room tone is extremely clean, indicating a studio environment with no ambient noise. (3) Frequent rustling sounds of thick paper pages are audible as the speaker flips through the book. These incidental noises have a broad frequency spectrum and sharp transients. The BGM maintains its major-key tonality, providing a cheerful acoustic bed for the high-density speech. (4) Short 'whoosh' sound effects, added in post-production, coincide with the rapid flipping of the split book pages. These effects have a quick attack and decay. The speaker’s voice shows high pitch variability, with rising contours used to maintain audience engagement. (5) The speaker's intensity remains high as he reads a list, his voice projecting clearly above the background music. The acoustic guitar continues with a simple, repetitive harmonic progression. No audio distortion or technical artifacts are present, and the overall mix has a high signal-to-noise ratio.
